content: Ŋità aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ Yɛsu
Abun, ngye, mwan baal amɛ, wal ngwal angye u kab a ngway alà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Ndaa kàwem ngye akà mɛ u mii a ambäl mbɔɔn, lɔŋ ya akà baar a lää ban'kwo mulɔŋ ya sye akà baar asin.
Wal kab a mpay làngye asànaa ŋità aŋàbwaŋ a Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Akà ŋità mwɛy tɛy afàköŋà indiir a mɛɛn mà isàkal naa nde akwen mupà un'sak akà mbuur kun'biil kà isal.
Abun sye unsà an'taam a unüün, akà ŋan'taam mwɛy uwal anki ndä isàkal naa nde uläb anki in'kɔɔn a unüün.
Kab a isaa atàtwɛb làtàkyà akà un'lem.
Yöb ndaa an'tɛn mɛ: Mwol ayapà un'yɛnà unsà indiir byanswà.
Un'yɔbà Yɛsu Klistɔ awà kàwiyà uboo a akü, awà mbuur a itoo a David, mulab Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ amɛ
alà in'kamanà mɛ mpay tii mukambääm in'siŋ asànaa un'dwää. Wɛɛ Ndaa a Nzam kà yàŋàbääm anki!
Lalan an'kääŋ mɛ mpem aya yanswà ntɔn bàŋàsɔɔl, ba sye bàwɛl mɔ̈ɔ̈, awà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, anà làkoo a mbul a in'tye.
Ndaa a ndandaa ban'kwo musà làkwikilà ayi:

content.text: « Kya bi isàkwà anà nde, bi isàkal sye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà nde.
Kya bi isàman mpay anà nde, bi isàyaal anà nde.
Kya bi isun'tɔn, nde sye akyɛr asitɔn.
Kya bi isàkɔɔn akal bàlää akà nde, nde wà wàlää taaŋ lanswà, ntɔn nde ukwe anki mutɔn nde ŋakwo. »

content: Un'syääl aŋàkyey
Yɔbà indiir abi, kyey u mii a Nzam naa yà ubwaŋ muwɛy an'sye ntɔn ngɔk ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ, naa tɛy ma idwa mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar bàweemà ma.
Sà ngwal ngye ŋàkwo mumɛnà u mii a Nzam asànaa mbuur aŋàtsim, un'syääl mpa awe anà nswɛn, awà afàlɔŋ aswalaa Ndaa a ndandaa.
Twon an'bilà unsà an'yääm ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ anà mpa màfàlab làkwikilà. Baar bàfàbilà afwee amu ma, bàfàkàtsü unsà imbuur.
Ndaa aba yà asànaa inkyär aŋàfüünà ifàdyà in'twaŋ. Imɛnɛ anà Filɛtɔs bà abun.
Ba bàkyàwɛy ndandaa, bàmudwa làkwikilà a baar mutɛn naa ngwiiyà yàkyàyà itaan.
Itàkal abun, an'sin a ngwal kàsi Nzam màŋàtsim, màŋàsà inyɛm a ndaa yi: « Mwol akyàyöb bànde » anà sye: « Wɛy mbuur wanswà afàtà ikɔb a Mwol din, utön an'kyän an'be. »
Uboo a ndwà a kölàköl, kà nà indiir a wɔl anà arza mpɛl byàfàkal, wɛɛ byàfàkal sye anà byà in'te anà byà tɔm. Byàtàtwɛb ntɔn ibyääl, byumwɛy ntɔn nsyääl a bunàbun.
Abun, isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy kan'pɔ̈ŋ nde ŋakwo mukaabà anà indiir abi, nde asàkal undiir mwɛy ntɔn ibyääl, wà in'kyɛɛl, wàndöŋ akà Un'lɔɔŋ, wàŋàkwo ntɔn isal aŋàbwaŋ.
Tiin ilään a ndür a itö, waa aleŋ bàlàbal, làkwikilà, ukwen, duu anà baar abà bàfàbel Mwol u mpem.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn mbaaŋ ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ anà yà upool, yöb naa ya ifàbɔr ngwiy.
Kyekà, un'syääl a Mwol ukwe anki munwan, wɛɛ nde akal mbuur bàkwen baar banswà, mbuur ayɔ̈b mulɔŋ, anà mukaŋ mpem.
Wɛy nde ulwɛŋ asyeel a mbaaŋ unsà duu: taaŋ lumwɛy Nzam ayapà mbwo musɔɔmà anà muyɔ̈b ndandaa,
muyàfurà unsà an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ, mutoo kà an'tɛy a ileŋ awà kakäär unsà isɔ ntɔn mulab ukwen ande.
